title: Data systems
blurb: Batch and stream processing over many machines, the logs that carry data between systems, and the formats, engines and lakes that store and query it.

main.why: You write map and reduce, and the framework handles distribution and failures.

main.title: Resilient Distributed Datasets: A Fault-Tolerant Abstraction for In-Memory Cluster Computing
main.why: Spark. Keeps data in memory and rebuilds lost pieces from lineage instead of copies.
Moving shuffle data to dedicated servers made local SSDs last 36 months instead of 3.

main.title: The Log: What every software engineer should know about real-time data's unifying abstraction
main.why: One ordered log of changes can feed every database, cache and data system.
Brokers store the log, and consumers pull and track their own position.
Splits each log into small segments, since whole partitions got too heavy at LinkedIn scale.
Copies a full table while streaming its changes, without locking it.

main.title: The Dataflow Model
main.why: Windows, watermarks and triggers for late and out-of-order events.

further.title: Discretized Streams: Fault-Tolerant Streaming Computation at Scale

main.title: Apache Flink: Stream and Batch Processing in a Single Engine
main.why: One engine for streams and batch, with batch treated as a bounded stream.

main.title: State Management in Apache Flink
main.why: Barriers in the stream trigger checkpoints of operator state, for exactly-once recovery.

background.title: Distributed Snapshots: Determining Global States of Distributed Systems

main.why: Exactly-once ad counting with Kafka transactions and Flink checkpoints, at 2 minutes of latency.

main.title: Dremel: Interactive Analysis of Web-Scale Datasets
main.why: Stores nested records by column, the encoding Parquet adopted.

further.title: Dremel: A Decade of Interactive SQL Analysis at Web Scale

main.title: Major Technical Advancements in Apache Hive
main.why: ORC. Built-in statistics let Hive skip the data a filter rules out.
Switching Parquet to ZSTD cut storage 39%, and sorting rows cut another table 32%.
An external index turns a key lookup in Parquet into one small read instead of a scan.

main.title: Delta Lake: High-Performance ACID Table Storage over Cloud Object Stores
main.why: A transaction log next to Parquet files gives ACID tables on object storage.

further.title: Lakehouse: A New Generation of Open Platforms that Unify Data Warehousing and Advanced Analytics

main.why: Hudi. Uber built it for incremental upserts, cutting data delay from a day to under an hour.
Notion's writes are mostly updates, which Hudi on S3 handles cheaper than Snowflake.
One SQL engine queries many data sources through connectors.
Storage in S3 and compute in separate clusters, each scaled on its own.
Kept its MPP engine but moved storage to S3 and added serverless.

main.title: Druid: A Real-time Analytical Data Store
main.why: Fresh data in memory plus immutable column segments give sub-second queries.

further.title: Pinot: Realtime OLAP for 530 Million Users

main.title: ClickHouse: Lightning Fast Analytics for Everyone
main.why: Writes sorted parts, merges them in the background and runs queries vectorized.
